name: Thragg

skins.name: Conquest
skins.lore: Conquest is an elderly Viltrumite warrior feared across the galaxy for his brutality, cruelty, and obsession with battle. During the Invincible War and later conflicts, he became one of Mark Grayson's deadliest enemies.

skins.name: Escape
skins.lore: The Escape skin represents Conquest after escaping Earth following his brutal defeat against Invincible and Atom Eve. Severely injured and stripped down after the battle, he fled the planet barely alive.

skins.name: Lucan
skins.lore: Lucan is a powerful Viltrumite warrior who participated in the attack on Thraxa alongside other Viltrumites sent to confront Omni-Man and Invincible.

skins.name: Anissa
skins.lore: Anissa is one of the strongest Viltrumite warriors in the Invincible series, known for her arrogance, loyalty to the Empire, and overwhelming strength.

skins.name: Thula
skins.lore: Thula is a ruthless Viltrumite warrior recognized for her long braid-like hair weapon and deadly combat abilities during the Viltrumite conflicts.

lore: Thragg is the strongest Viltrumite in the Invincible comic series and the former Grand Regent of the Viltrum Empire. Known for his overwhelming strength, brutality, and combat skill, he is considered one of the deadliest beings in the universe.
